free_tier.stated: No free tier: Object Storage bills the stored capacity and, on some classes, restored data, with no charge for API calls, incoming or outgoing traffic; new customers get a one-time USD 200 credit for a first Public Cloud project

egress.terms: Free: no charges for API calls, incoming traffic or outgoing traffic

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project; Visa, Mastercard and Maestro cards are accepted, and PayPal and a prepaid account are offered as payment methods

reliability_note: 99.9% availability SLA for a 1-AZ deployment and 99.99% for a 3-AZ deployment
confidence_note: documented: the international price list, the storage classes page, the Object Storage technical limits page, the account-creation guide and the free-trial page were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; a read timed from a bucket would make it measured

evidence.proved: No free storage tier at all; S3-compatible and 'no hidden fees for ingress/egress or API calls', but you pay for stored GB from the first one. Only a $200 new-customer trial credit.

evidence.quote: Amazon S3* compatible solution: robust security, peak performance from the first GB, and highly competitive pricing.

evidence.proved: Object Storage bills stored capacity and, by class, restored data; no free capacity is offered
evidence.quote: Our model is simple and transparent: you only pay for the stored capacity, as well as restored data, depending on the [storage class](https://www.ovhcloud.com/en/public-cloud/object-storage/classes/) chosen.

evidence.proved: Object Storage charges nothing for API calls, incoming or outgoing traffic
evidence.quote: there are no charges for API calls, incoming traffic, or outgoing traffic.

evidence.proved: a valid payment method is required on the account before the first Public Cloud project
evidence.quote: You need to add a valid payment method to your OVHcloud customer account before starting the free trial, which will be used after your free trial ends, if you want to keep running the project you have launched.

evidence.proved: OVHcloud accepts Visa, Mastercard and Maestro cards; the same page offers PayPal and a prepaid account
evidence.quote: Cards accepted are Visa, Mastercard, Maestro.

evidence.proved: account creation validates the email address with a one-time code
evidence.quote: After you submit this form, a one-time code will be sent to the email address you entered.

evidence.proved: the USD 200 credit is one-time, for a first Public Cloud project only
evidence.quote: Please note, however, that this offer is only valid for your first project. i.e., you must never have created a Public Cloud project.

evidence.proved: Object Storage availability SLA is 99.9% in 1-AZ and 99.99% in 3-AZ
evidence.quote: 99.9% SLA for a 1-AZ deployment and 99.99% for a 3-AZ deployment.

notes: No free storage tier at all; S3-compatible and 'no hidden fees for ingress/egress or API calls', but you pay for stored GB from the first one. Only a $200 new-customer trial credit.
